notes: WhaleChat 3.57.4 — the app now auto-connects to the Appwrite sync server even when an old host was saved (health probe uses the new URL, failed hosts are dropped, and a 12-second watchdog reconnects). Admin > Servers now shows the live email state and saves Brevo correctly. The admin panel adds an Email & notifications audit log for every Brevo verification code, welcome mail, test and broadcast with delivery status, plus an in-app notification log, a verified-sender view and a session lock/unlock flow.
